tasks.name: [RM23] the port is pinned: the root catalog names 0.2.0 exactly and the resolved package is 0.2.0
[RM23] a state id is split on dots: #T1.4/x names the node T1 and the path 4/x; #T1_4/x resolves
[RM23] a final state inside a parallel region still takes events
[RM23] an onDone target re-enters the parallel region and resets its children; onDone without a target does not
[RM23] a pure transition on a done snapshot still runs a microstep
[RM23] raised and done events carry no time, while the event sent in does
[RM23] snapshot tags are an array, not a Set, and hasTag reads them
[RM23] an eventless loop past the iteration cap fails with a TransitionError; a shorter one does not
[RM23] the walk limit counts dequeued edges, not keys
